WITH usage AS (
            SELECT
                ob.organization_id AS organization_id,
                o.name AS organization_name,
                ob.researched_allowance AS researched_allowance,
                (
                    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer
                    FROM organization_researched_accounts ora
                    WHERE ora.organization_id = ob.organization_id
                      AND ora.removed_at IS NULL
                ) AS active_researched_count
            FROM organization_billing ob
            JOIN organizations o ON o.id = ob.organization_id
            WHERE ob.researched_allowance > 0
         )
         SELECT
            organization_id AS "organization_id!: Uuid",
            organization_name AS "organization_name!",
            researched_allowance AS "researched_allowance!",
            active_researched_count AS "active_researched_count!",
            (active_researched_count >= researched_allowance) AS "at_cap!"
         FROM usage
         WHERE active_researched_count >= CEIL(researched_allowance::numeric * 0.9)::integer
         ORDER BY organization_id ASC
